items.title: Chester Jones Interview, 1961-07-10
items.q: Let Harrison take that band, take that charge of that job

ctx.x: And you were playing with Harrison, you were playing both drums. Yeah.

That was my first job, I played both drums. What caused that, because Howard had two jobs that night and he didn't want to let the jobs go see. Let Harrison take that band, take that charge of that job and he went on down to Grand Island and play. That's where he got to go down to Grand Island that night. And we played this other job.
Well let's try to work out the dates on this. You know roughly how old you were. How old were you when you started taking out the bass drum at home? Even with the Kazoos?
